--- AS204208 Peering Policy ---

Policy: Open
Contract: Not required (route server) / Required for bilateral
IPv4: Yes (min /24)
IPv6: Yes (min /48, dual-stack mandatory)
RS Peering: All route servers at all IXPs
Bilateral: Min 50 Mbps 95th% sustained over 30 days
Ratio: Up to 4:1 (bidirectional) for bilats; RS otherwise
MD5: Required on bilats
BFD: Required on bilats (300ms min interval)
Multilateral: Accepted via route servers

Requirements:
- Valid IRR objects (RPKI preferred); unrouted prefixes may be filtered
- Up-to-date PeeringDB record with NOC/abuse contacts
- 24-hour abuse response SLA
- No default routes or statics toward our prefixes
- No MED manipulation or community stripping
- No transit resale of our routes
- No hijacked or disputed prefixes

We reserve the right to de-peer without notice for route leaks,
prefix hijacking, persistent abuse, or sustained ratio violations.

Contact: noc@peravix.co.uk
Abuse: abuse@peravix.co.uk
